name: The Bluebird Restaurant (Logan) Historic Roast Beef / Turkey Dinner & Dinner Rolls
brandOrRestaurant: The Bluebird Restaurant (Downtown Main St · Logan, UT)
whyItWorks: Operating on Logan Main Street since 1914, The Bluebird serves old-fashioned homestyle roast beef, turkey, mashed potatoes, and soft white dinner rolls that are gentle and unspiced.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the traditional Roast Beef or Turkey plate with mashed potatoes and soft rolls (or the Country Breakfast with scrambled eggs and toast); avoid the "Rajun Cajun" and "Bluebird Huevos" green chili dishes.
watchOuts: Avoid the Rajun Cajun Omelet (andouille sausage & lemon cream cheese) and green chili dishes
